messages.subject: INLA install fail
parts:
Hello,

I'm having an error when trying to install INLA. I had it previously installed but had to be re-installed. I tried multiple fixes as there was multiple errors mentioned, so I installed Rtools42 (I have R 4.2.2) and the two packages "RgraphviZ" and "graph". However, I now get the following message:

install.packages("INLA",repos=c(getOption("repos"),INLA="https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable"), dep=TRUE) Installing package into ‘C:/Users/jerome.baron/AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.2’ (as ‘lib’ is unspecified) There is a binary version available but the source version is later: binary source needs_compilation INLA 23.04.24 24.06.27 FALSE installing the source package ‘INLA’ trying URL 'https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable/src/contrib/INLA_24.06.27.tar.gz' Content type 'application/x-gzip' length 62225912 bytes (59.3 MB) downloaded 59.3 MB * installing *binary* package 'INLA' ... cp: unknown option -- ) Try '/usr/bin/cp --help' for more information. ERROR: installing binary package failed * removing 'C:/Users/jerome.baron/AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.2/INLA' Warning in install.packages : installation of package ‘INLA’ had non-zero exit status

I would be grateful if you could advise on what to do next.

Thank you,
Jerome
